g.title: J10
g.text: EPS J10 (zone Z3), wing W1: drivers Q24 (W1A, BURN_W1A PB10) and Q25 (W1B, BURN_W1B PE6)

g.title: W7A_B
g.text: M22759/33-24 (Micro-Fit minimum); pairs twisted; 0.88 A for 12 s, one resistor at a time; under the EPS, along the +X wall gap below the EPS (within 20 mm of y = 0) and down the (+X, -Y) bundle to the burn board; loop 50 mohm, 44 mV

g.title: W7A_S
g.text: sense pair, twisted, down the +X hinge-side strip

g.title: BB_W1
g.text: wing W1 burn board (two burn resistors), solder pads

g.title: HS_W1
g.text: wing W1 deployed-state sensor lead, AS81824/1 splice

g.title: J11
g.text: EPS J11 (zone Z2), wing W2: drivers Q26 (W2A, BURN_W2A PB9) and Q27 (W2B, BURN_W2B PE7)

g.title: BB_W2
g.text: wing W2 burn board (two burn resistors), solder pads

g.title: HS_W2
g.text: wing W2 deployed-state sensor lead, AS81824/1 splice

g.title: J12
g.text: Pico-Clasp 501330-0600, gold terminals (EPS J12 as Pico-Clasp 6, was 4)
EPS J12 (zone Z5): AntS supply (SW8, DEPLOY_EN) and I2C (U80 B side)

g.title: W7C
g.text: M22759/33-28; pairs 1+3, 2+4, 5+6; 0.61 A peak on two wires per pole (34 %), 37 mV

g.title: ANTS
g.text: through the -Z end-frame cut-out at (-31, -16); pinout from the AntS ICD

g.title: W12A
g.text: twisted pair; microamperes; 10 k at the EPS end limits a short to the frame to 1.7 mA

g.title: J16
g.text: 5 pos (pin 3 not connected on the EPS)
EPS J16 (zone Z2): pole 1 pack-return FET drive (PACK domain), pole 2 array inhibit (TRK_EN), EPS_BOARD_DESIGN D 6.2

g.title: W12B
g.text: pole 1 triple (1, 2, 3; 3 spare) and pole 2 pair (4, 5) twisted; microamperes

g.title: DS2
g.text: deployment switch DS2, two-pole (DPDT) (rail -X-Y, -Z), solder terminals

g.title: W12C
g.text: +X wall gap at y -39.5 ... -45.5 (beside W4A), from the +Z rail end down to the EPS

g.title: W12D
g.text: -Y wall strip and the -Y deck slot; pole A in DS2's drive, pole B clamps TRK_EN

g.title: RBF
g.text: RBF switch, two poles, solder terminals
